column1: # Call uses of `*-shared-view*` identifiers in src/ and stdlib/ (definitions
# excluded) that scripts/check-shared-view-count.sh allows. A change that
# removes views lowers max_uses to the new count; never raise it.
# One exception: a one-time raise of max_uses from 20188 to 20873 for the
# sequence-accessor migration (#8920 only), authorized by the maintainer on
# 2026-10-15: "ok to raise now, the final goal is 0". Before it, each
# compiler-ir-*-seq-ref call made an unchecked copy inside one of nine accessor
# bodies, so this count saw nine. Of the 1,859 call sites, 1,174 now borrow the
# slot and 685 (598 in the compiler, 87 in its tests) copy through a
# -seq-shared-view twin named at the call site. The twins are transitional:
# converting a site to a borrow removes its view and lowers max_uses here.
